risks.risk: The TV may have more than transformer damage (e.g., main board, T-con, backlight/inverter), which would reduce value further.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the power supply/transformer area showing the blown component(s), plus a photo of the board part numbers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as scrap/parts only (worst case: not reliably repairable).

risks.risk: Screen may be damaged (panel failure) even if the transformer is blown.
risks.proof: A power-on video (10–20 seconds) showing any backlight glow/boot behavior, ideally with brightness changes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working (worst case: panel not usable).

risks.risk: Size/brand may be incorrect; could be a different TV than claimed.
risks.proof: Photo of the rear label/sticker with brand, model number, and screen size.
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest comparable that matches 'scrap LG flatron TV' style worst-case.

proof_requests: Photo of the rear rating label/sticker (brand + model number + screen size).
Close-up clear photos of the power supply board/transformer area showing the exact blown part(s).
Short power-on video showing backlight/boot (even if no picture).
Any included accessories (remote/stand) shown clearly, or confirm none.
response.reason: From the single dark photo, the brand/model/size and the specific transformer-only fault cannot be verified, so a reliable worst-case price cannot be confidently matched to the correct comparable.
